Professional Summary
Senior Product Manager with 7 years of experience — 3 years in port and terminal operations at JNPT, followed by
4 years in logistics SaaS product roles. Deep understanding of how freight moves through Indian ports, the
operational pressures on freight forwarders and CHAs, and where software consistently fails them. Led product
function independently at a startup for 2.5 years.
Work Experience
Head of Product (SPM-equivalent)
Portwise Technologies Pvt. Ltd. (Port & Logistics SaaS, 55 employees), Mumbai · Aug 2022 – Present
— Led the product function as the sole senior PM for 2.5 years — owned roadmap, discovery, and delivery with no PM
manager; reported directly to co-founder
— Rebuilt the entire product architecture from a single monolith to a modular suite after understanding that freight
forwarders needed to adopt specific features without the full platform commitment — decision made after 3 months of
customer discovery, not based on engineering preference
— Shipped 12 features in 3 years; killed 4 post-launch based on usage data; one killed feature was my own idea from
the previous roadmap cycle
— Designed the JNPT container tracking integration after understanding the ICEGATE API limitations from my time in
terminal operations — feature worked because I knew what the data actually contained, not just the field names
— Grew managed accounts from 8 to 34 over 2 years; sat in on every new customer onboarding in the first year to
understand where the product broke
Senior Product Manager
LogiStack Technologies (Freight Management SaaS), Mumbai · Jan 2021 – Jul 2022
— Owned the freight booking and carrier allocation module — led a 4-person squad
— Shipped a multi-carrier rate comparison feature that increased booking conversion from the platform by 22%

ticket by 60%
Terminal Operations Executive → Senior Operations Executive
JNPT (Jawaharlal Nehru Port Trust), Nhava Sheva · Jun 2017 – Dec 2020
— Managed berth allocation, vessel scheduling, and container handling coordination at JNPT's Terminal 4

— Led the night shift terminal operations team of 18 for 14 months — managed emergency cargo releases, vessel

— Built the shift's first digital container dwell-time tracker; port management adopted it across 2 other shifts within 3
